text:
maria-infra: Heads up — shipment SG-WH3 (PO# 789234) landed but flagged at customs for HS code mismatch. GPUs held. AWB 123-4567890. Losing prod capacity tomorrow if not cleared. Any updates?

alex-ops: Link to the tracker? how many units exactly are on hold?

sam-supply: Vendor update: 24 units (A100-80GB revB) on hold. Discrepancy: commercial invoice used generic 'accelerator modules' phrasing, customs wants exact model and MT/HS. Broker requested more docs.

jin-vendor: Sorry — export ops used wrong tariff code on the paperwork. Escalating with APAC customs broker. If broker can correct docs we expect 48-72h clearance. If customs insists, could escalate to physical inspection (adds days). Will DM corrected invoice. :pray:

maria-infra: That timeline is rough — we lose ~40% training throughput and autoscale for dedicated pools tomorrow. We need minimum 8 GPUs for inference-critical queues and 16 for overnight retrains.

alex-ops: Short-term mitigation options: 1) reroute some units from JP warehouse (cross-dock), 2) swap allocations with non-prod reserve, or 3) on-demand cloud burst (expensive). What's cost/time for cross-dock?

sam-supply: Reroute offer: can move up to 12 units from JPN-WH1. Transit + import ~18h + paperwork. Expedited cross-border fee ~$2,000/unit + VAT/deposit. If you want full 24, need 2 shipments.

jin-vendor: We can also issue partial RMA if any DOA found, but RMA won't bypass customs hold. If you want serial-level swap now we can prioritize picking specific serials for cross-dock.

maria-infra: Cost tradeoff: pay ~$48k to reroute 24 units vs wait 2-3 days. Training SLAs degrade ~40% (customer-facing). Can vendor discount expedited fee or offer credit?

sam-supply: Pushed to vendor acct mgmt — tentative: 25% credit on the expedited fee if you commit to next-quarter allocation of 200 units. Need exec OK.

alex-ops: For immediate mitigation infra will evict lower-priority batch jobs and scale down Canary tests to free ~10 GPUs. Also can throttle retrain concurrency. Maria, please execute the canary fallback plan.

maria-infra: Doing now — shifting canaries to CPU fallback and pausing nightly retrains. Opening a billing ticket to approve up to $30k of expedite spend if needed.

logistics-bot: RMA created: RMA-2026-0043 for serials S12345-S12368. Tracker: https://carrier.example/track/123-4567890 

jin-vendor: Added customs broker contact: broker-apac@vendorlogistics.com. I'll DM corrected commercial invoice PDF and revised HS code. If broker accepts, ETA 48h. If not, will priority-reroute 12 units to JP in 18h.

maria-infra: Thanks. One request: please attach the corrected invoice and a packing manifest with serials in the DM and post a redacted copy here for our customs team. If customs holds beyond 72h we trigger cross-dock. Tagging @sam-supply and @jin-vendor — please confirm final ETA once you have broker acknowledgement. :wave:
